caribbean.headline: Heavy Rain Likely in Martinique; Seas Remain Light
caribbean.paragraph: Martinique is experiencing heavy rain with 100% rain probability, easterly winds near 13 kt and seas 2.6 ft with an ESE swell period of 7 s. I expect poor visibility and ponding on low-lying streets around Fort-de-France and advise mariners off Freeport to exercise caution with 19 kt winds and choppy 2 to 3 ft seas.

mediterranean.headline: Rough Seas Near Mykonos Prompt Small Craft Concerns
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos is experiencing sustained northeasterly winds to 26 kt, seas up to 7.2 ft with a dominant NNE swell at a 7 s period, and 38% rain probability. I advise caution for small craft; conditions meet Small Craft Advisory criteria for the eastern Mediterranean, while Marseille is seeing lighter 17 kt winds.
